(333)phur pa rgyud lugs las/sri gnon rgya gram nag po bzhugs/(334)bcom ldan 'das mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/rdo rje phur pa'i sgo

tei:div.tei:p: (333)phur pa rgyud lugs las/ sri gnon rgya gram nag po bzhugs/ (334)

bcom ldan 'das mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas sri gnon pa'i thabs la sbyor dgos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stobs po che'i rgyud las/ rgyal pa phur pa'i phung sri ni/ mon dang hor mo spyi ring mgor/ chos 'khor dbus su gnas par bya/ yang na yul gyi mdo nyid do/ dgra sri rta g.yag thod pa ru/ dgra zun mtshams su gnan par bya/ dam sri g.yi spyang thod pa ru/ grong gi dbus su gnan par bya/ blon po phung ba'i pho sri ni/ spre'u'am ni tshe pha wang thod/ (335) bdun pa 'du bar gnan par bya/ yul khams phung ba'i phung sri ni/ mjo rtol dre'u thod pa ru/ yul gyi dbus su gnan par bya/ dme yis phung ba'i phung sri ni/ g.yi dang gsal spyang thod pa ru/ grong brdal chen po'i dbus su mnan chung sri khyi phag thod pa ru/ mal gyi 'og tu mnan par bya/ dur sri wa thod grum thod dam/ yang na zer mo'i thod pa ru/ dur gyi 'dabs su mnan par bya/ rnal 'byor dam sri mi dang khyi/ phag thod la sogs snod du ni/ mchod rten 'og tu gnan par bya/ (336) god sri ra lug thod pa ru/ ra ba'i dbus su gnan par bya/ zhes pas snod dang gnas bstan cing*/ de'i nang du sri can so so'i liṅga bca' tshul ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug bris pa la/ dbus su dang tri bri'o/ dgra la byed na nṛ yang bri/ rtsibs drug la ni sngags drug bri/ mtha' la khro bcu'i sngags kyis bskor/ dbus kyi lte bar gzugs bri la/ snying gar rus la dpral bar ming*/ yan lag bzhi la yig 'bru bzhi/ mā ra ya yis mtha' ma bskor/ sngo dmar dkri zhing re bas gtum/ zhes pas 'khor lo myu khyud gsum pa'i lte bar dgra ste ma gtogs sri can liṅga thams cad mi gzugs bya mchu can gyi snying gar dgra la nṛ dang*/ gzhan rnams la tri yig ja sprod kyi bar du gtems pa'i mtha' skor du jaḥhūm̐ (337) baṃ hoḥmo ha gha ya che ge mo oṃ badzra aṅku sha jaḥ

che ge mo hūm̐ jaḥ zhes pas bskor/ dpral bar sri can gang yin gyi ming spel bcug pa'i mnan sngags dper na/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ rgyal po phung ba'i phung sri st+wambha nan/ zhes dang*/ yan lag bzhi la jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gzugs kyi mtha' skor du mā ra ya nan rnams bri/ mu khyud gnyis par 'khor lo rtsibs drug gi mgo thog nas rim par g.yas bskor du/ ha sa ya ra sogs sngags drug po bri/ mu khyud gsum par khro bcu'i sngags mthar che ge mo st+wambha nan/ zhes dang*/ phyi rol ja khram khyis bskor/ dha du ra dang dug khrag gis dbyugs/ gtor zlog dang 'brel na zor gtor gyi 'og tu bye stegs kyi brug khang nang du bcug (338) gal te sri gnon rkyang pa byed na lcags kyi hom khung ngam/ sla nga bye mas bkang bar brub khung brus pa'i nang du liṅga bcug la kha khyer rtsang gis srin mo 'gros su bskor ba'i steng bsnyen phur dar nag bkab pas gzir/ ske shang nyung dkar lcags zangs phye la dug khrag gis ngar btags pa'i thun rdzas dang*/ mnan snod phung re sogs kyang tshogs par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bsnyen bsgrub gdab las tshul bzhin bya/ zor dang hom dang mnan pa dang*/ tha mas las su grub pa yin/ zhes pa'i don las dang po bsnyen bsgrub ni/ stegs mtho bar yi dam dang chos srung gi mchod gtor tshogs par byas la/ sgrub thabs 'bring bsdus gang rigs kyi gzhung srong nas bzlas pa ci nus bya'o/ gnyis pa gdab las ni/ gtor bzlog dang 'brel na (339) gzu dpang dang*/ dam can gyi bskul/ bzhi snying dril ba'i bzlas pa gsum gyi mjug tu bla 'gugs kyi pho nya mo bzhi'i dgos bskul dang sri can 'gugs pa'i sngags ci nus re spel nas tshar gang 'os ldag gal te sri mnan rkyang pa byed na/ dam can mchod bskul bsdus pa byas ma/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/

ma ra sya na pra marta ni ye sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ de nas blal 'bugs kyi pho nya mo bzhi bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi pho nya las mkhan (340)mo/ dkar mo dung gi mche ba can/ mkha' la 'byung ba'i mjod 'khyil/ lag na spu gris sems can sgrol/ zhal du dgra bo'i snying khrag rngub/ sprul pa thog thog ser chen 'bebs/ pho nya sum brgya drug cu 'gyed/ sum brgya drug cu'i gtso mo ste/ bskal pa brgyad khri'i pha rol nas/ dam las 'das pa'i bla 'dren ma/ nyams pa'i bla la nan ma chung*/ lho yi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni/ nag mo lcags kyi lan tshar can/ khyung gi (341)khra thogs g.yas pa na/ bhandha gri thogs gsod la rngams/ tshangs pa bsgyings pa'i cha lugs can/ mi sdug mgo la gcer bu'i lus/ pho nya sum brgya drug cu 'gyed/ sum brgya drug cu'i gtso mo ste/ bskal pa brgyad nas bla tshol tshol/ dpag tshad bye bar bla 'gugs 'gugs/ nyams pa'i bla dang srong la ya/ nub kyi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni/ dkar mo nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ma/ gdug pa 'dul la drag po ste/ gsod la (342)rngams pa'i las la brtson/ mche gtsigs g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ sum brgya drug cu'i gtso mo ste/ rab tu bsgrub nas bla 'gugs ma/ nyasam pa'i bla dang srog la ya/ byang gi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni/ ljang nag 'khyil ba'i thod gdengs can/ ser mo ral can 'bum gyis bskor/ phyag na ral gri gsod la rngams/ sum brgya drug cu'i gtso mo ste/ sngon nas sri can bla 'gugs ma/ nyams pa'i bla dang srog la ya/ nam mkha'i lha mo phur (343)pa'i lha/ lag brgya lcags kyi phur pa 'dril/ spyan brgya khrag gi mchi ma 'jag zhal brgya gdug pa'i ngan sngags zlos/ tshems kyis skye shi rtsa ba gcod/ phur pa'i las mkhan chen mo ma/ rab tu mi bsrun las la brtson/ pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed/ rdo rje sku gsung thugs las sprul/ nyams pa'i bla dang srog la ya/

zhes bskul/ blal 'gugs sngags ni/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra aṅku sha jaḥ rgyal sri hūm̐ jaḥ zhes pas mtshon (344) brgya'am stong phrag re'i mtshams su pho nya bskul ba ci nus bya'o/ de nasazan ling ri bsham ma phyi dro'i thun la gdab las re bya ba'o/ dang po bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ (245)gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ zungs shig chings shig rnam par chings/ rengs par khug la smrar chug cig lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog nga yi dbang du gyur nas ni/ bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par gyis/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ che ge mo/ ha sa ya ra hri tan a be sha ya a be sha ya/ shi kri a na ya shi kri a na ya/ dzwa la sa ya dzwa la sa ya/ ta thā ya ta thā ya/ (346)bandha ya bhandha ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa bzla/ gsum pa gnas lung ni/ hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas/ rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha nan/ mo ha gha ya bha ga wān shi kri bi kri shri badzra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhi pa phur gdab ni/ hūm̐/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyalal ba'i gdung gsob pa'i/ rig 'jin (347)bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang*/ dngos grub phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/

mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma tha ma tha (348)hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ pu ru pu ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ mu ru mu ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ ka tang ka te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ja ye bi ja ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te ma ra sa na pra marta na ye sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mjod/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ra big nan sarba big tan hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bindha (349)bindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ghri ha na ghri ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lnga pa bsad gris gzir zhing*/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i/ mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra/ su ru su ru badzra/ mu ru mu ru badzra/ sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (350) drug pa thun dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ka tang ka te/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra syai na pra marta ni ye hūm̐ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ma tang nya ka ra i nan dha ti ma ma karma shi kraṃ ka ra ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (351) bdun pa gtun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/

rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdau rje tho bas brdung byas nas/ lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur/ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ/ nyer gcig brjod/ brgyad pa bstab pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ bsgo ba'i bka' ni nyan par byos/ (352)hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya badzra yaksha kro dha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ gal te gtor zlog dang 'brel na zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrangs nas/ thun gtor 'phang ba yan chad nyin ltar bya'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ gtor zlog dang brel na nyin tha mar zor lam dbye ba nas bzung 'phang ba'i las yan chad sngon du byas nas las mtha' mnan pas bsdu ba'i tshul zor dang hom dang mnan pa dang*/ tha mal las su grub pa yin/ zhes pas bstan la/ de'i tshul yang*/ gang du byed pa gru gsum grus/ e yi tshogs kyi gzhal yas bskyed/ stobs po che yi thugs saka nas/ jaḥlas lcags kyus dgug cing bstim/ thod pa'i nad du sbas nas ni/ sobs po (354) che yi phur pas gdab/ rgya gram mnan cing las bzhis brdung*/ gang la byas kyang the tshom med/ ces pa ltar lto 'phye la mi gnod pa'i chogs dong tshad dang ldan pa brus la/ dgra 'dre so so'i lte ba tshul gyi rū pa rang snod du bcug tshon skud sngo dmar gyis dkris/ phung res gtums la mnan par sleb pa dang*/ bzhi bdag dang klu ma dkar gtor bsngos rjes/ mnan dong gshin rje nag po'i lto bar bsam pa'i nang du mnan chas bskyur la/ thun brdeg dug khrag gtig dug gtor bsgyur/ gu gul bdug dur g.yam la stong rgya bris pas bkab pa'i steng phur pa gcig stobs po cher bsams la gzir/ hūm̐/ sri can bsgral ba'i zhing yin te/ sangs rgyas bstan (354)pa khyod kyis bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis smad/

dge la rgyab kyi phyogs pa khyod yon bdag rnams la gnod pa byas/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi sku la bsdos/ tshe rabs snga ma'i lan chags pa/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i sri/ gru gsum 'bar ba'i 'dir stsal bas/ nor gyi dgos nas ming rus 'di/ rdo rje khro bo 'khor bcas kyi/ zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las mjod/ sri can 'di las 'dre che med/ sri can 'di las tshe ring med/ tsha ba'i dbal dang gson (355)gyi babadud/ gshin gyi lcags su che ba'i sri/ chung sri rgyal blon dmangs kyi sri/ rje khol zhang tsha tsha yi sri/ pha sri bu sri nu bo'i sri/ dgra sri dme sri phung ba'i sri/ dur sri gdo sri sgo sri rnams/ sri can ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ dpal chen khro bau'i skur bsgoms nas/ thams cad rdul du brlag par bya/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i phur bu bstan/ gshin rje nag po'i lto bar gzhug ya ma rā ja'i zas su sbyin/ ma mo rnams la mchod par 'bul/ pho nya rnams (356)kyi 'gugs 'dren bya/ ri rab chen po'i rmad du sba/ gshin rje'i bu yi lag tu gtad/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du bskyur/ mtshon chen 'bar ba'i rtse mos bcad/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbal gyis gdab/ ye shes rnon po'i rtse la gtad/ rakta 'bar ba'i rba la btang*/ nyung dkar sel med 'bem du gzugs/ gu gul sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug dug gi gtor mas myos su 'jug lcags phye zangs phyi'i dbal gyis gcad/ gtun khung rdo rje tho bas brdung*/ (357)(358)khro bo rol pa'i tshogs su dbul/ dgra bgegs snying la snying gzer gdab/ byang chub sems ni ma skyes bar/ nam yang btang bar mi bya'o/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+wambha nan/ zhes brjod/ sa dang me chu'i rgyas 'debs spel rjes/ steng du lag pa lu gu ryud du bro brdung*/ sumbha ni brjod/ nang du log nas tshe 'gugs/ nyer bsdu/ shes brjod sogs spyi ltar bya ba nyid do/ dge'o/// /
